From prompt to survey, quiz, or poll

Questions, question types, skip logic, scoring, and the result screen or dashboard, generated in one pass. Refine any question or result by describing the change you want.

Every response in a database you own

Responses land in a database in your Emergent project that you own. No response cap, no annual limit, no per-response overage, and no upgrade to see older responses.

Skip logic and scoring on every plan

Show questions by earlier answers, weight answers toward result buckets, calculate a score, and route by outcome. Included from the free tier, with no upgrade for advanced logic.

Result screens, dashboards, and leads

A personalized result screen per respondent, a live dashboard your team can filter, and lead capture that sends the score, archetype, and source to Slack, HubSpot, or Klaviyo.

Native integrations, plus webhooks

HubSpot, Salesforce, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, Slack, and Zapier work natively. Anything else connects over a webhook, with no approved-partner list.

Full code export to your repository

The survey, quiz, scoring logic, dashboard, and database schema export to your GitHub. Keep hosting on Emergent or take it anywhere, with every past response coming along.

props.value: How to create a survey, a quiz, or a poll
props.name: Heading

props.value: Satisfaction, engagement, fit, preference, or knowledge. A CSAT survey and a product quiz look alike but answer different questions, and a poll is a survey cut to one or two questions with live results. The measurement decides the questions and the scale.
props.name: HW_Step_01_des

props.value: Every survey needs a decision it enables: cut the churn driver, prioritize the feature, fix the onboarding step. Every quiz needs a result, such as an archetype, a recommended product, or a qualified lead. Every poll needs a shareable moment. Write the outcome first, then work backward to the questions.
props.name: HW_Step_02_des

props.value: For surveys and questionnaires, keep to the minimum you need to act on. Every extra question costs completions. For quizzes, ten to fifteen single-select questions is the sweet spot, and every option should map cleanly to a result. Read every draft question and ask: would two different outcomes answer this differently?
props.name: HW_Step_03_des

props.value: 04 Set the logic and the scoring
props.name: HW_Step_04_Title

props.value: Decide which questions depend on earlier answers, which answers weight toward which result, and how ties are broken. For quizzes, break ties with the last differentiating answer, not random selection, so the same visitor gets the same result on a second run. On Emergent this is a sentence.
props.name: HW_Step_04_des

props.value: 05 Build the result screen or the report
props.name: HW_Step_05_Title

props.value: Every quiz needs a result: a title, a one-paragraph description, three to five example next-steps, and one clear action. Every survey needs a report: a live dashboard the team can filter, an export, and an alert on the answers that matter. Polls need a live results view. All three are generated with the questions.
props.name: HW_Step_05_des

props.value: 06 Wire lead capture, database, and integrations
props.name: HW_Step_06_Title

props.value: Add the email step where it makes sense, and save every response to a database you own by default. Push high-intent completions to Slack and to your CRM as new leads with score, archetype, and source attached. On most other tools this is a separate setup; on Emergent it is one sentence.
props.name: HW_Step_06_des

props.value: 07 Publish, embed, or run it conversationally
props.name: HW_Step_07_Title

props.value: Publish as a standalone page on your own domain, embed on any site, or run one question at a time as a conversational flow. Watch completion rate. If most people who start don't finish, trim questions first, then improve from there once you have the data.
props.name: Text
